name: Markdown Plugin
description: Markdown preview viewer with multi-tab support. Renders .md files via marked.parse() with sanitized HTML (raw HTML escaped, javascript: links blocked, target=_blank on external links). Per-tab scrollTop tracking for position preservation on tab switch. External file change detection via fs:onChanged with auto-reload (preserves scroll on same content, scroll-to-top on different). State serialization/restoration including legacy single-file format migration. Handles empty files (shows '<Empty file>'), deleted files (shows header read error), and loading errors gracefully. Tab bar with close buttons.

dependencies.usage: Right-click tab context menu (Close, Close Others, Close All, Copy File Path)

methods.name: closeOtherTabs
methods.description: Close all tabs except the one specified

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Read .md file, create or switch to tab, render preview

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restore tabs and scroll positions from saved state

features.marked_rendering: marked.parse() with custom Renderer for HTML escaping and link sanitization
features.multi_tab: Multiple .md files open with tab bar and close buttons
features.scroll_tracking: scrollTops Record stored per filePath, restored on tab switch
features.external_reload: fs:onChanged listener — reloads file, preserves scroll if content unchanged
features.state_migration: Supports legacy format (single file with filePath/scrollTop fields) and new format (openFiles[], activeFile, scrollTops{})
features.error_handling: Empty files: '<Empty file>', deleted files: error header message, parse errors: catches and shows inline
features.tab_drag_reorder: Drag-and-drop tabs to reorder them via native HTML5 DnD. Visual feedback during drag (opacity on source, border-left indicator on hover target). Triggers onStateChange after reorder.
features.tab_middle_click_close: Middle-click (mouse button 1) on any tab closes it without switching.
features.tab_context_menu: Right-click on tab opens ContextMenu with: Close, Close Others (keep only this tab), Close All (clear all tabs), Copy File Path (copies full path to clipboard via clipboard:writeText).
features.tab_auto_scroll: Active tab auto-scrolls into view in the tab bar when switching (inline: nearest).
